name: Frank Stanley
original_name: フランク・スタンリー
source:
[url=/c74677]Jack Stanley[/url]'s younger brother, and a member of the Chicago Police Department's Bomb and Arson Squad.

Two years prior, he was killed attempting to disarm an explosion at a high-class hotel in Chicago, orchestrated by [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url].
